title: Finance Standard — Amount of a Final Credit Refund on the Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
**Rule.** A credit balance left on a final-billed Utility Pass-Through Service account is refunded by check to the former resident at the mailing address on the profile, on the former resident's request. The refund is the credit balance less the most recent personal-check payment when fewer than 5 days have passed since it was received, and less the most recent bank-account payment made through the resident portal when fewer than 2 days have passed since it was received, the days counted by subtracting the receipt date from the handling date. A refund is never below zero, no more than 250.00 dollars is refunded at one time, any credit not refunded stays on the account for a later refund, and the refund is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Terms

- **Credit balance**: the amount by which the utility balance is below zero; a balance of zero or above is no credit.
- **Most recent personal-check payment**: the latest payment on the account received as a personal check at the community office.
- **Most recent bank-account payment made through the resident portal**: the latest one-time bank-account payment made in the resident portal (an automatic bank draft is not such a payment).
- **Days passed**: the handling date less the date the payment was received.

## Order of the calculation

1. Start from the credit balance.
2. Take off the most recent personal-check payment if fewer than 5 days have passed since it was received.
3. Take off the most recent portal bank-account payment if fewer than 2 days have passed since it was received.
4. If the result is below zero, the refund is zero.
5. If the result is above 250.00, the refund is 250.00 and the rest of the credit stays on the account.
6. Round half up to the cent, once.

## Worked figures (handling date 15 August, hypothetical)

| Credit balance | Personal check (received) | Portal bank payment (received) | Working | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 180.00 | 60.00 on 12 August (3 days) | 40.00 on 13 August (2 days) | check held, bank payment not held: 180.00 less 60.00 | 120.00 |
| 180.00 | 60.00 on 10 August (5 days) | none | nothing held | 180.00 |
| 410.00 | none | none | above 250.00 | 250.00; 160.00 stays on the account |
| 50.00 | 70.00 on 14 August (1 day) | none | 50.00 less 70.00 is below zero | 0.00 |
